finding: Authored and embedded LCD phase fields have no production reader. The native phase reaches blob construction, but its biased origin is subtracted again before painting at the original origin; outside rounding and the existing special phase correction, the added phase cancels. General pixel behavior remains unverified.
further_findings: Custom Fontations outline construction hard-codes hinting, edging and subpixel choices by TextRasterPolicy. Public custom text settings need complete semantic review.
The current source contains special 10px phase and y-origin corrections. Their general shared causes require proof before release qualification.
owner: openui-paint and openui-text raster policy flow
required_followup: Implement and verify every public raster field through real native apps.
Reduce phase differences using matching physical glyph origins and repeated pinned Chromium captures.
Qualify default native rendering, including C and C++.
Do not promote transport ownership tests as proof of complete rendering semantics.

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
pub enum RasterPixelGeometry {
    Unknown,
    RgbHorizontal,
    BgrHorizontal,
    RgbVertical,
    BgrVertical,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
pub struct TextRasterConfiguration {
    pub edging: TextEdging,
    pub hinting: TextHinting,
    pub subpixel_positioning: bool,
    pub force_autohint: bool,
    /// Horizontal LCD phase in 1/64 physical pixel units.
    pub lcd_phase_64ths: i16,
}
